items.text: An MBA in rural management and development leads to roles in agribusiness, cooperatives, rural finance, development organisations, public programmes and rural marketing, and it works best for people who want field-level problem solving and are willing to work outside big cities.
Pick between business, finance and programme roles, spend time in a rural setting before enrolling and judge programmes by where graduates actually work.
Programme approvals, fees and placement claims vary.
